id: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Goh:
en: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Goh:
it: Smart Rotom: chiamata in arrivo da Goh:

id: \bGoh: \PN, I need you to come back to Vermilion City right away! I think I've found a Zapdos.
en: \bGoh: \PN, I need you to come back to Vermilion City right away! I think I've found a Zapdos.
it: \bGoh: \PN, devi tornare subito ad Aranciopoli! Credo di aver trovato uno Zapdos.

id: \bWait, meet me at Route 10. It's to the east of Vermilion.
en: \bWait, meet me at Route 10. It's to the east of Vermilion.
it: \bAspetta, raggiungimi al Percorso 10. Si trova a est di Aranciopoli.

id: Cianwood City\nA Port of Crashing Waves.
en: Cianwood City\nA Port of Crashing Waves.

id: \rThis is a great place to sit back and relax.
en: \rThis is a great place to sit back and relax.
it: \rÈ un posto perfetto per sedersi e rilassarsi.

id: Cianwood City Pharmacy\n 500 Years of Tradition\n We Await Your Medicinal Queries
en: Cianwood City Pharmacy\n 500 Years of Tradition\n We Await Your Medicinal Queries
it: Farmacia di Fiorlisopoli\n 500 anni di tradizione\n Rispondiamo a ogni domanda sui medicinali

id: \bI want to go swimming, but my dad said no.
en: \bI want to go swimming, but my dad said no.
it: \bVoglio andare a nuotare, ma il mio papà ha detto di no.

id: His Roaring Fists do the Talking
en: His Roaring Fists do the Talking
it: I suoi pugni ruggenti parlano per lui

id: \bNo matter how many times we break them these rocks, just keep coming back.
en: \bNo matter how many times we break them these rocks, just keep coming back.
it: \bNon importa quante volte le spacchiamo, queste rocce tornano sempre.

id: \bWelcome to the Olivine Cruiser. Unfortunately we are not sailing right now due to engine failure.
en: \bWelcome to the Olivine Cruiser. Unfortunately we are not sailing right now due to engine failure.
it: \bBenvenuto a bordo dell'Olivine Cruiser. Purtroppo al momento non stiamo salpando a causa di un guasto al motore.

id: \bLooks like the Whirlpools stopped us from going all the way. Explore the islands for now until they clear.
en: \bLooks like the Whirlpools stopped us from going all the way. Explore the islands for now until they clear.
it: \bA quanto pare i Mulinelli ci hanno impedito di arrivare fino in fondo. Per ora esplora le isole finché non si calmano.
